page.overview:
Who is Francisco the Fearless?

Francisco the Fearless is a minor character in the 1983 James Bond film Octopussy. He is played by stuntman Richard Graydon.

Francisco the Fearless is man who gets shot out of a cannon at Octopussy's circus. He offers a bit of comic relief after the tense disarming sequence.
